Same Day IPA 2026. Kegged FRESH in Bathurst from 12:01am Thursday 6th of August 2026 and delivered fresh & cold to 22 venues across NSW, QLD, ACT & VIC to be tapped simultaneously at 6pm the SAME DAY. 

Thank you to the below venues for participating in this insane idea of ours!

Brew Nation, ACT. Goods Shed Wodonga. Hopheads Altona. Bar Josephine. Grape & Grain Moorabbin. Carwyn Cellars. Fitzys Toowoomba. Sneaky Baron. The Woods Bar. The Scratch Bar. Saccharomyces Beer Cafe. Wellers Hill Bowls Club. Oxford Tap House
My Beer Dealer Alfred St. Bankstown Brewhouse. Petersham Bowlo. The Mitch. Bitter Phew. Wingmill Neutral Bay. Wingmill Dee Why. Pourhouse Maitland.
The Clarendon Newcastle.

Double West Coast IPA. Proudly Reckless.

items.badge_description: Yeow! You' are Fully Sacch! A fully certified Saccharo nutter. Take a moment. You deserve it. You worked hard and drank the shizzel outta those beers.  A big congrats and high five. Keep checking in to level up and reap the rewards!

Looking for more kick than a session beer, but want to be able to stay for a few rounds? You have to keep it in the middle. That's 220 beers with an ABV greater than 5% and less than 10%. Try 5 more for Level 45!
Do you come from the land down under, where beer does flow, and men chunder? That's at least 165 different beers from Australia. Try 5 more for Level 34.
